description: Implementation of a Hume-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) service class, including methods for initializing, starting, stopping, updating settings, and streaming synthesized speech with word timestamps.

classes.name: HumeTTSService
classes.description: A service class for Hume's TTS, supporting streaming PCM audio with word timestamps, dynamic parameter updates, and metrics.

classes.name: HumeTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: Data model for optional synthesis parameters such as description, speed, and trailing silence.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HumeTTSService with API key, voice ID, optional parameters, and sample rate.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates if the service can generate metrics (returns True).

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service and resets internal state.

methods.name: _reset_state
methods.description: Resets internal timing and state variables.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and closes HTTP client resources.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the service and closes HTTP client resources.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming frames, resetting state on interruption or stop.

methods.name: update_setting
methods.description: Updates runtime settings such as voice ID, description, speed, and trailing silence.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Generates speech from text, streaming PCM audio and word timestamps, handling errors and timing.
